floater.name: wolf_recorder
floater.title: Video Recorder

wolf_recorder_transport_button.label: Record
wolf_recorder_transport_button.name: record_btn
wolf_recorder_transport_button.tool_tip: Start recording what you see and hear. Press again to stop and save.

wolf_recorder_transport_button.label: Pause
wolf_recorder_transport_button.name: pause_btn
wolf_recorder_transport_button.tool_tip: Pause the recording. Nothing is recorded until you press Resume.

button.label: Play
button.name: play_btn
button.tool_tip: Play the video you have just saved, in this computer's video player

button.label: Open folder
button.name: saved_folder_btn
button.tool_tip: Show the folder your videos are saved in

button.label: Get the video codec (free, from Cisco)
button.name: codec_btn
button.tool_tip: Downloads Cisco's free H.264 video codec to this computer. Only needed when the computer's own video encoder cannot be used.

floater.text: OpenH264 Video Codec provided by Cisco Systems, Inc.

combo_box.name: size_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: The size of the video picture. Your window is fitted inside, with black bars when its shape differs.

combo_box.name: fps_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: How many pictures a second the video aims for. When WolfViewer draws fewer, the video has fewer.

check_box.label: Show my windows, menus and name tags in the video
check_box.name: show_ui_check
check_box.tool_tip: Off: only the world is recorded. On: the whole window, as you see it. This window and the REC sign are never in the video.

floater.text: The bars show how loud each sound is while you record.

check_box.label: World sound and music
check_box.name: world_check
check_box.tool_tip: Sounds, music and media as you hear them

slider.name: world_level
slider.tool_tip: How loud the world sound is in the video

view.name: world_meter
view.tool_tip: How loud the world sound is in the video, while you record: green is good, amber is loud, red (with the word Loud) is too loud - move the slider down.

check_box.label: Voice chat (other people)
check_box.name: voice_check
check_box.tool_tip: Other people's voices as you hear them in voice chat

slider.name: voice_level
slider.tool_tip: How loud voice chat is in the video

view.name: voice_meter
view.tool_tip: How loud voice chat is in the video, while you record: green is good, amber is loud, red (with the word Loud) is too loud - move the slider down.

floater.text: Other people's voices will be recorded - please ask before sharing.

check_box.label: My microphone
check_box.name: mic_check
check_box.tool_tip: Your own voice, for talking over the video. Not sent to voice chat.

slider.name: mic_level
slider.tool_tip: How loud your microphone is in the video

view.name: mic_meter
view.tool_tip: How loud your microphone is in the video, while you record: green is good, amber is loud, red (with the word Loud) is too loud - move the slider down.

floater.text: The microphone is only switched on while a recording runs, and off while it is paused. With speakers, it also picks up the world sound.

button.label: Change...
button.name: change_folder_btn
button.tool_tip: Choose the folder your videos are saved in

button.label: Open folder
button.name: open_folder_btn
button.tool_tip: Show the folder your videos are saved in

combo_box.name: limit_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Whether a recording stops by itself after a set time. With Never it runs until you press Stop; it still stops by itself, and says so, if the disk gets nearly full.

floater.string: Start recording what you see and hear. Press again to stop and save.
Stop recording and save the video.
Pause the recording. Nothing is recorded until you press Resume.
Carry on recording, in the same video.
Press Record to start. Press Stop when you have finished, and the video is saved.
Recording. Press Stop to finish and save the video.
Paused - nothing is being recorded. Press Resume to carry on, or Stop to save.
Recording - it stops by itself at [END].
The saved video is no longer in its folder.
This computer's sound system could not start the route the world sound is recorded from.
World sound can only be recorded with the OpenAL sound engine.
[FREE] free - room for about [TIME] of video at this size.
[FREE] free - about [TIME] left at the current rate.
